_meta: 프랑스어 회화 음성 — 목소리·감정·자리 채움. 일본어앱 data/tts/voices.json 과 같은 짜임. 참고 음성은 VoxCPM2(설명 instruct 는 영어).
base_text: Ce soir, j'ai une réunion, alors j'ai tout préparé ce matin. Et quand ce sera fini, on pourra dîner ensemble, tu veux bien ?

am.desc: A French young man in his twenties, clear and gentle voice

af.desc: A French young woman in her twenties, clear and soft voice

camille.desc: A French woman in her early twenties, quick, witty and direct voice

lea.desc: A French woman in her early twenties, dreamy, soft and slightly breathy voice

hugo.desc: A French man in his mid twenties, relaxed, warm and joking voice

theo.desc: A French man in his mid twenties, frank, energetic and slightly deep voice

man_y.desc: A French man around twenty, natural and clear voice

man_m.desc: A French man in his forties, steady and calm voice

man_o.desc: A French man in his seventies, aged and gentle voice

woman_y.desc: A French woman around twenty, natural and clear voice

woman_m.desc: A French woman in her forties, composed and kind voice

woman_o.desc: A French woman in her seventies, aged and warm voice

kid.desc: A French child around eight years old, small and bright voice

announce.desc: A clear, even French female announcer voice, like a station or airport announcement

robot.desc: A flat synthetic machine voice, like a kiosk or payment terminal

neutral.instruct: calm and natural, everyday tone, natural conversational pace, subtle
neutral.ref: Ce soir j'ai une réunion, donc je prépare mes documents maintenant.

polite.instruct: polite and professional, like a clerk or station staff, natural conversational pace, subtle
polite.ref: Bonjour madame. Votre commande est prête. Je vous souhaite une bonne journée.

stiff.instruct: very nervous and stiff, formal and overly polite, natural conversational pace, subtle
stiff.ref: Merci beaucoup de me recevoir. Je ferai de mon mieux. Je vous remercie de votre confiance.

cheerful.instruct: cheerful, bright and friendly, natural conversational pace, subtle
cheerful.ref: Ah, tu es là ! Il fait super beau, ça va être une belle journée.

amused.instruct: amused, laughing warmly, relaxed, natural conversational pace, subtle
amused.ref: Ha ha, c'est trop drôle ! Vas-y, continue comme ça.

teasing.instruct: teasing, playful and mischievous, natural conversational pace, subtle
teasing.ref: C'est quoi cette tête ? Allez, dis-moi tout. Je ne le répéterai à personne.

excited.instruct: excited, bursting with energy, bright and loud, natural conversational pace, subtle
excited.ref: J'ai réussi, j'ai réussi ! Je n'en reviens pas. Merci, merci beaucoup !

surprised.instruct: surprised, caught off guard, voice jumps, natural conversational pace, subtle

shout.instruct: raised voice, comic disbelief, not screaming, natural conversational pace, subtle
shout.ref: Quoi ? Maintenant ? Mais je fais comment, moi ?

tsukkomi.instruct: a quick sharp comic retort, exasperated but fond, natural conversational pace, subtle
tsukkomi.ref: Mais non ! Pourquoi tu l'as mis là ? Oh là là, toi alors.

annoyed.instruct: annoyed, irritated, sighing, natural conversational pace, subtle
annoyed.ref: Encore ça ? Bon, ça suffit, on arrête d'en parler.

sad.instruct: sad, quiet, voice slightly trembling, natural conversational pace, subtle
sad.ref: Je suis juste un peu fatigué. Ce n'est rien.

worried.instruct: worried and anxious, hesitant, natural conversational pace, subtle
worried.ref: Ça va ? Tu es sûr ? Tu devrais peut-être voir un médecin.

flustered.instruct: flustered and embarrassed, stammering, unsure, natural conversational pace, subtle
flustered.ref: Euh, attends, je ne sais pas trop quoi dire, en fait.

shy.instruct: shy, soft, slightly trailing off, natural conversational pace, subtle
shy.ref: Ah... c'est que... moi aussi, j'aime bien. Alors... on y va ensemble.

gentle.instruct: gentle, warm and tender, quiet, natural conversational pace, subtle
gentle.ref: Ce n'est pas grave. Prends ton temps. Je suis là.
